description: LFO tracing a roulette curve, one ellipse rolling around another with a pen fixed to the rolling one; the pen's horizontal and vertical positions come out as two voltages.

params.text: Sets the size of the fixed shape against the rolling one, 1 to 10; the rolling shape turns that many times for each turn of the fixed one.
Sets how much of the voltage at the RATIO input changes the size ratio, from full inverted to full; 10V at full adds 20.
Stretches the rolling shape, 1 to 10; at 1 it is a circle.
Sets how much of the voltage at the eG input stretches the rolling shape, from full inverted to full; 10V at full adds 10.
Stretches the fixed shape, 1 to 10; at 1 it is a circle.
Sets how much of the voltage at the eF input stretches the fixed shape, from full inverted to full; 10V at full adds 10.
Sets how far the pen is from the centre of the rolling shape, 0.1 to 10; at 1 the curve becomes a cycloid, with cusps that touch the fixed shape.
Sets how much of the voltage at the D input moves the pen, from full inverted to full; 10V at full adds 10.
Sets the rate the fixed shape is traced, from one turn in 256 seconds to 16Hz.
Sets how much of the voltage at the FREQ input changes the rate, from full inverted to full; at full it is a volt per octave.
Sets where on the rolling shape the pen starts, 0 to 360 degrees.
Sets how much of the voltage at the θG input moves the pen's starting point, from full inverted to full; 10V at full is a whole turn.
Sets where on the fixed shape the trace starts, 0 to 360 degrees.
Sets how much of the voltage at the θF input moves the starting point on the fixed shape, from full inverted to full; 10V at full is a whole turn.
Scales the horizontal output, from silent to twice its size.
Sets how much of the voltage at the Xamp input scales the horizontal output, from full inverted to full; 10V at full covers the whole range.
Scales the vertical output, from silent to twice its size.
Sets how much of the voltage at the Yamp input scales the vertical output, from full inverted to full; 10V at full covers the whole range.
Chooses whether the rolling shape runs around the outside of the fixed shape or around the inside of it.
Chooses the range of both outputs: centred on 0V, or with 5V added to each.

inputs.text: Voltage changing the size ratio through its attenuverter.
Voltage stretching the rolling shape through its attenuverter.
Voltage moving the pen's starting point on the rolling shape, through its attenuverter.
Voltage stretching the fixed shape through its attenuverter.
Voltage moving the starting point on the fixed shape, through its attenuverter.
Voltage moving the pen away from the centre of the rolling shape, through its attenuverter.
Voltage changing the rate of the trace through its attenuverter.
Voltage scaling the horizontal output through its attenuverter.
Voltage scaling the vertical output through its attenuverter.

outputs.text: The horizontal position of the pen.
The vertical position of the pen.
